findings.title: Referer-based embed check is weak, and X-Frame-Options is set to ALLOWALL
findings.body: Access is gated only on the Referer header host, which is spoofable by non-browser clients and is often stripped. The response then sets X-Frame-Options to ALLOWALL, which lets any site frame the page. Use a CSP frame-ancestors restriction on the allowed host instead of ALLOWALL.

findings.title: Unescaped request.referer interpolated into inline JavaScript string
findings.body: `'<%= request.referer %>'` is ERB-escaped as HTML, not as JS. A referer containing a single quote or a backslash can break out of the string. HTML escaping also turns & in the query string into &, which corrupts the targetOrigin, so postMessage silently fails. The value should be a JS-escaped origin, not the full referer URL.

findings.title: Mutating `contents` in place, and unescaped URL in HTML
findings.body: `contents <<` mutates the caller's string. It raises FrozenError if the string is frozen, and it appends the footer repeatedly if the caller reuses the string. The url is also interpolated into an href without escaping, so a crafted URL containing a quote can inject HTML. Raw HTML posts are not sanitized.

findings.title: Kernel#open on a setting-supplied URL
findings.body: `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` uses Kernel#open from open-uri. This allows local file paths and, on older Rubies, pipe commands like `| cmd`. Use URI.parse(url).open, or restrict the value to http(s) URLs.

findings.title: Kernel#open on user-influenced embed_url (SSRF)
findings.body: import_remote calls `open(url)` with embed_url taken from a request parameter. The host check passes, but redirects, or the embeddable_host resolving to internal addresses, can lead to SSRF. Using Kernel#open also permits file and pipe access. Use an explicit HTTP client and validate the scheme.

findings.title: Nil content or String#scrub crashes the job
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError when a feed item has no content element (e.g. summary-only feeds). String#scrub also does not exist on Ruby < 2.1. One bad item aborts the whole poll.

findings.title: Malformed ERB `end if`
findings.body: `<%- end if %>` is invalid Ruby: `end` followed by a dangling `if` modifier is a syntax error. This will break rendering of the template.

findings.title: Missing topic or view yields errors; test and code disagree
findings.body: The spec expects TopicRetriever.new to be called from the request, but the controller enqueues a job instead, so the 'tells the topic retriever' test fails or tests the wrong behavior. In the success path the 'loading' render is followed by discourse_expires_in, and best.html.erb renders the topic_view with a stubbed nil in the spec.

findings.title: Origin check uses indexOf substring match
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a substring of discourseUrl, including an empty or partial origin. Compare for exact origin equality instead.
